numeric_policy.metric: development pair balanced accuracy, percentage scale
numeric_policy.aggregation: exact rational arithmetic on source decimal strings; equal seed weights
numeric_policy.table_precision: two decimal places, round half to even
numeric_policy.ranking: highest unrounded three-seed mean within each arm and decoder
numeric_policy.ties: retain every exactly tied highest mean; join labels with / in Raw/PCA/Time/Native order
numeric_policy.display_ties: rounding may show equal values whose unrounded means differ
numeric_policy.range: minimum and maximum of the three computational seed scores

interpretation: Rankings are post-hoc descriptions of three computational repeats.
The rankings provide no validated model-selection procedure or significance test.
All observed seeds share the same historically exposed development arrays at a fixed roster.
Known-label construction and shared exposed development limit generalization claims.
Seed ranges describe computational variation; biological uncertainty remains unestimated.
A representation's ranking is conditional on the arm and readout.
